description: All numerical inputs are values printed in the case-study article (El-Saeed et al., Sci. Rep. 15 (2025) 19949, ref. [29] of the audit paper) as transcribed in Saeidfirozeh et al., 'Can a published CF-LIBS quantification be reconstructed? A reproducibility-audit framework and reporting checklist'. No raw spectra are used.

validation_table.source: Table 6 of ref. [29]; audit paper Table 1

stark.source: Eq. (2) of the audit paper, reproduced as printed in ref. [29]

S1-Ptest.comparison_note: ref. [29] prints 1.54382e17 cm-3; 1e16 is inferred from the validation-table inversion, not a corrected measurement

ne_concentration_equations.source: Table 4 of ref. [29]; N_e = (a + b*C) * 10^16 cm-3, C in ppm

te_concentration_equations.source: Tables 4-5 of ref. [29]; T_e = a + b*C in K, C in ppm

Fe.note: negative intercept; domain-limited statistical fit, not a general physical relation
